title: HelpSteer 2: Open-source dataset for training top-performing reward models
paper_type_zh: 人工偏好数据、奖励模型与 SteerLM 对齐研究
best_for_zh: 需要可商用人类偏好数据和多属性奖励信号的研究者。
one_line: HelpSteer2 is a CC-BY-4.0 preference dataset of about 10,000 response pairs for efficient reward-model training.
发布 HelpSteer2 开源人类偏好数据，以可解释的多维质量属性和偏好对训练高性能通用奖励模型。
why: It shows how rich human preference attributes and a small, permissively licensed pair set can support reward modeling and downstream alignment.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on an open dataset for reward-model training with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: HelpSteer2 targets reward-model training data whose labels explain why one response is better. The paper releases roughly 10K human-rated response pairs and keeps the response-level five-axis contract of HelpSteer—helpfulness, correctness, coherence, complexity, and verbosity—rather than reducing quality to a single opaque preference bit.
HelpSteer2 面向的是能说明“为什么一个回答更好”的奖励模型训练数据。论文发布约 1 万个人工评分的回答对，并保留 HelpSteer 的五维回答级契约：有用性、正确性、连贯性、复杂度和冗余度，而不是把质量压缩成不透明的单个偏好位。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Its contribution is a compact, deliberately curated preference resource for training reward models. A pair is interpretable because the underlying response attributes can be inspected; the intended learning signal is not merely “chosen beats rejected,” but a comparison grounded in dimensions that can conflict, such as concise versus complete.
贡献是一份紧凑、刻意策展的偏好资源。每个对可解释，是因为可检查其底层回答属性；学习信号不只是“优胜大于劣胜”，而是建立在可能相互冲突的维度上，例如简洁与完整之间的权衡。

title: Method
方法
html: Annotators score candidate responses across the five dimensions; pairs are assembled from those judgments for reward-model training. NVIDIA trains reward models and SteerLM2-related systems with the release, and publishes the dataset on Hugging Face under CC-BY-4.0 with NeMo-Aligner as the implementation path. Reproduction needs the exact score-to-pair rule, prompt subset, answer sources, and treatment of ties.
标注者在五个维度上给候选回答评分，再据此组装用于奖励模型训练的成对样本。NVIDIA 以该发布训练奖励模型和 SteerLM2 相关系统；数据在 Hugging Face 以 CC-BY-4.0 发布，NeMo-Aligner 是实现入口。复现须固定从分数到成对样本的规则、提示子集、回答来源和并列项处理。

title: Evidence
证据
html: At release, the paper reports a model trained with its recipe reaching 92% on RewardBench. That figure is evidence that the data/recipe combination is useful on that benchmark, not that five scalar dimensions exhaust human preference. Check whether a reported RM uses the original labels, a binarized derivative, or additional data.
论文在发布时报告，其配方训练的模型在 RewardBench 上达到 92%。这只说明数据与配方组合对该基准有效，不代表五个标量维度穷尽了人类偏好。必须核对报告中的 RM 使用原始标签、二值化派生标签还是额外数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with large anonymous preference pools, HelpSteer2 makes the annotation axes explicit and emphasizes data quality over raw volume. The direction signal is reusable attribute-level provenance for a pairwise objective. It is not a new preference-optimization loss and it does not turn response ratings into universally calibrated utilities.
相较于大规模匿名偏好池，HelpSteer2 显式给出标注维度并强调数据质量而非纯规模。其方向信号是为成对目标保留可复用的属性级来源；它不是新的偏好优化损失，也不会把回答评分变成普遍校准的效用。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The five axes can be correlated, culturally contingent, or insufficient for safety and factuality in specialized domains. Score aggregation and pair construction introduce researcher choices; reward models can exploit verbosity or style artifacts. Audit rater agreement, score distributions, response-source leakage, and behavior on adversarial prompts.
五个维度可能相关、受文化影响，且不足以覆盖专业领域的安全性与事实性。分数聚合和成对构造都引入研究者选择，奖励模型也可能利用冗长度或文风伪线索。应审计标注一致性、分数分布、回答来源泄漏和对抗提示表现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use HelpSteer2 for reward-model ablations, studies of attribute-to-preference conversion, and small-scale preference tuning where data provenance matters. It is a poor sole source for multilingual alignment, medical/legal advice, or safety moderation.
适合奖励模型消融、研究属性到偏好的转换，以及重视数据来源的小规模偏好微调。不应单独作为多语种对齐、医疗/法律建议或安全审核的数据来源。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Record dataset revision, license, five-axis definitions, normalization, pair-generation threshold, response generator, model checkpoint, and evaluation template. Evaluate each axis and length-controlled subsets; an aggregate RewardBench score cannot reveal which label dimension the model learned.
记录数据版本、许可、五维定义、归一化、成对生成阈值、回答生成器、模型检查点和评估模板；按维度及长度控制切片评测，总 RewardBench 分数不能说明模型学到了哪个标签维度。
